parsed.rationale: The reported failure, timeout, and active charging-interlock indicator are supported and cover the outcome and bounded diagnostic units. Approximately 0 m is supported rounding of the sampled odometry travel (about 0.00000854 m), with source and window scope preserved. However, its expressed 1 m resolution does not meet the required 0.1 m or finer resolution, so the odometry unit is not covered.
